shortDescription: Create a table in an SQLite database.

options.name: column_order
options.description: Specifies a full or partial column order to use when creating the table.

options.name: columns
options.description: Columns for the table in the form of a dictionary, where the key is the column name and the value is the column type. Supported Python types are "str", "float", "int", "bool", "bytes", "datetime", "date", and "time".

options.name: db_path
options.description: Path to the SQLite database. Make sure the database file is accessible and writable.

options.name: defaults
options.description: Specifies default values for specific columns.

options.name: if_not_exists
options.description: If set to True, does nothing if table already exists.

options.name: ignore
options.description: If set to True and table already exists, silently ignores the operation.

options.name: not_null
options.description: Specifies columns that should be NOT NULL.

options.name: pk
options.description: Specifies which column should be the primary key when creating the table.

options.name: replace
options.description: If set to True, drops the table if it exists and creates a new one.

options.name: table
options.description: Name of the table to create.
